review_type: read-only source review; no runtime or JVM executed
working_tree_warning: OccupiedRideReloadValidation and its test were untracked; FontReloadValidation was modified. Base commit alone does not identify reviewed sources; hashes below do.
requirement: Prove occupied Fourth Dimension ride motion and relevant rendering after successful resource reload; retain broader FD401 acceptance boundaries.

findings.problem: Passenger predicate does not establish an FD rider binding or motion.
findings.source: OccupiedRideReloadValidation.tick: player.isPassenger() is the sole vehicle predicate.
findings.counterexample: With generation advanced and 100 global geometry stages, a stationary vanilla boat passenger accumulates 20 ticks and passes. This is a source-derived counterexample, not an executed Minecraft scenario.
findings.required_evidence: Resolve the local FD seat/carrier/chassis binding, require the expected family and stable identities, and measure native chassis displacement after reload.

findings.problem: Occupancy and geometry evidence need not overlap or be continuous.
findings.source: postReloadGeometryStart is set before isPassenger; occupiedTicks never resets on dismount.
findings.counterexample: 100 geometry stages before boarding followed by 20 stationary passenger ticks passes, even if no geometry renders during occupancy. Two ten-tick rides separated by a dismount also satisfy the tick threshold. Source-derived, not executed.
findings.required_evidence: Baseline geometry on qualifying occupancy and collect consecutive same-identity occupied samples; restart observation on dismount, world change or binding loss.

findings.problem: Font generation does not prove successful completion of the requested resource reload.
findings.source: FontReloadTrace.applyStart increments generation; OccupiedRideReloadValidation never inspects reload future success or FontReloadValidation.completed.
findings.counterexample: Generation advancing is accepted independently of the overall reload future result. An absent overlay is not an explicit success assertion. No failed-reload runtime was performed.
findings.required_evidence: Use an explicit successful reload completion token for the requested generation, fail on error, and require observation after that completion.

findings.problem: Static observation state is not reset when the client level changes.
findings.source: TrackRenderMetrics resets on level changes, while initialGeneration/postReloadGeometryStart/occupiedTicks remain static.
findings.impact: A second world can inherit prior occupancy and generation state, while reset render counters produce misleading differences or delay completion.
findings.required_evidence: Bind observation state to the level/session and reset or fail upon disconnect/world change.

test_scope: Existing new unit test covers property bounds and malformed numeric input only; it does not exercise acceptance logic.
claim_boundary: No observed runtime success is invalidated solely by this review; the gate cannot by itself establish the stronger claim. Preserve raw run evidence as passenger/render smoke evidence unless additional identity/motion/reload evidence supports a narrower real ride.
coordination: Findings sent to FD401 owner and core coordinator. Owner retains source edits and runtime scheduling. No integration expansion or gate closure authorized.
